docs.text: A very hot summer thus far in the western basin of Lake Erie, but the work goes on!

Spring Waves 🌬️🌊🍃 March is always an exciting time on the Great Lakes. The lakes open up, the winds pick up, the days are longer and the waves are back! #rosmanphoto #surf #photography #GreatLakes #Canada
Same here. Taking a plunge into Lake Erie during single-digit temps sounds so much more appealing and worthwhile. 🏊‍♂️❄️
If it’s 85 degrees in late September on Lake Erie, you go all out and enjoy your last beach day of the summer.
Lake Erie is VERY warm this year. I really hope we don't get an algae bloom. 84 if is where Cedar Point is (I know it's an old pic with Wicked Twister. But man I miss Wicked Twister)
True... I summer on Lake Erie. Way milder than TC
It's brisk here, just south of Lake Erie, as well.

Lake Erie is still cool.
Those northerly breezes
coming in off the lake can be rather chilling.
Lake Erie always provides in the summer! Cools us off when we most need it!
Lake Erie Walleye Trail tournament Director Jason Fischer says the tourney moves eastward throughout the summer to beat adverse conditions the heat has on the walleye in the western basin.
